messages:
Aisha Kaur: Hey team — saw CS playbook spikes in the last hour, a ton of accounts moved to 'Onboard: Waiting' even though they completed forms. Noticed this after the new rule update. Anyone else seeing this?
Ben Ortiz: yup saw the alert. looks like the conditional that checks 'form_submitted = true' got inverted in the latest rule commit. :facepalm: cs-ops-bot alerted at 09:12 UTC.
cs-ops-bot: [ALERT] playbook:onboard-complete — 4,243 triggers in 10m (expected ~120). Rule version: v2026-03-21-8.
Evan Li: I pulled the rule diff — line 27 changed from `if not form_submitted` -> `if form_submitted` when we merged the new dedupe branch. Seems like a logic inversion.
Priya Menon: can we pause the playbook while we fix? we have CS agents pinging customers about missing next steps.
Ben Ortiz: pausing now — /playbook pause onboard-complete --reason "regression"
cs-ops-bot: [ACTION] playbook:onboard-complete paused by Ben Ortiz at 09:20 UTC.
Aisha Kaur: thanks. Ben, can you run a dry run to find affected accounts so we can send a corrected batch message? SQL sample I used:```sql SELECT account_id, user_email FROM accounts WHERE last_playbook='onboard-complete' AND triggered_at > now() - interval '1 hour';```
Evan Li: running that now. ETA ~2m. Also capturing top 10 examples for SRE logs and to reproduce locally.
Evan Li: results: 4,243 rows. Sample: acct_7682 (simon@acme.co), acct_9182 (maria@shopio.com) — storing in /mnt/csops/temp/onboard-misfire-4332100000.csv
Priya Menon: can we script a remediation to mark those who actually completed as "Onboarded" and only reopen where truly missing steps? avoids duplicated outreach.
Ben Ortiz: agreed. plan: 1) revert rule change in repo (hotfix branch), 2) run idempotent remediation script that checks `verified_submission` before forcing state change, 3) bump rule tests to include this case.
Aisha Kaur: PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/onboard/playbooks/pulls/142 — hotfix with unit test added.
cs-ops-bot: [DEPLOY] hotfix v2026-03-21-8-hotfix deployed to staging at 09:38 UTC.
Evan Li: ran remediation dry run: ```python remediations/fix_onboard_state.py --input onboard-misfire-4332100000.csv --dry-run``` flags 412 accounts to set to 'Onboarded', 38 to leave open for CS review.
Priya Menon: I'll review the 38 manually and coordinate outreach. thanks for the split — much better than bulk re-marking.
Ben Ortiz: merging hotfix to main after Priya OKs the 38. Also adding a small regression test in CI that simulates duplicate webhook + dedupe rule to prevent this.
Aisha Kaur: one follow-up: let's add a telemetry flag in Console to show "rules changed" per playbook so CS can see sudden delta spikes without paging SRE. Filed dashboard ticket: RED-OPS-768.
Evan Li: +1. Also writing a short runbook entry under CS-ops runbooks: "playbook spike triage" with the exact steps we did. Will link to the PR and remediation script.
Priya Menon: great — will notify CS leads and send a short customer-facing note for the handful who got duplicate nudges. :memo:
Ben Ortiz: closing loop — postmortem in #postmortems once we have timelines. For now, playbook is paused and remediation dry-run validated.
Aisha Kaur: thanks everyone. tagging @cs-ops-bot to keep audit trail. :white_check_mark:
